rewritten_query:
WITH store_brands AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND i.i_category IN ('Children', 'Men', 'Women')
      AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 49 AND 58
      AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
),
catalog_brands AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND i.i_category IN ('Children', 'Men', 'Women')
      AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 49 AND 58
      AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
),
web_brands AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
),
cross_brands AS (
    SELECT sb.i_brand_id, sb.i_class_id, sb.i_category_id
    FROM store_brands sb
    JOIN catalog_brands cb
      ON sb.i_brand_id = cb.i_brand_id
     AND sb.i_class_id = cb.i_class_id
     AND sb.i_category_id = cb.i_category_id
    JOIN web_brands wb
      ON sb.i_brand_id = wb.i_brand_id
     AND sb.i_class_id = wb.i_class_id
     AND sb.i_category_id = wb.i_category_id
),
avg_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(sales_amt) / SUM(row_cnt) AS average_sales
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) AS sales_amt,
               COUNT(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) AS row_cnt
        FROM store_sales ss
        JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
          AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
        UNION ALL
        SELECT SUM(cs.cs_quantity * cs.cs_list_price),
               COUNT(cs.cs_quantity * cs.cs_list_price)
        FROM catalog_sales cs
        JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
          AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
        UNION ALL
        SELECT SUM(ws.ws_quantity * ws.ws_list_price),
               COUNT(ws.ws_quantity * ws.ws_list_price)
        FROM web_sales ws
        JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
          AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
    ) x
),
target_weeks AS (
    SELECT MAX(d_week_seq) FILTER (WHERE d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 9) AS week_1999,
           MAX(d_week_seq) FILTER (WHERE d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 9) AS week_1998
    FROM date_dim
),
store_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_brand_id,
        i.i_class_id,
        i.i_category_id,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) FILTER (WHERE d.d_week_seq = tw.week_1999) AS ty_sales,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.d_week_seq = tw.week_1999) AS ty_number_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) FILTER (WHERE d.d_week_seq = tw.week_1998) AS ly_sales,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.d_week_seq = tw.week_1998) AS ly_number_sales
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN cross_brands cb
      ON i.i_brand_id = cb.i_brand_id
     AND i.i_class_id = cb.i_class_id
     AND i.i_category_id = cb.i_category_id
    CROSS JOIN target_weeks tw
    CROSS JOIN avg_sales av
    WHERE d.d_week_seq IN (tw.week_1999, tw.week_1998)
      AND i.i_category IN ('Children', 'Men', 'Women')
      AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 49 AND 58
      AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
    GROUP BY i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id, tw.week_1999, tw.week_1998, av.average_sales
    HAVING
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) FILTER (WHERE d.d_week_seq = tw.week_1999) > av.average_sales
        AND SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) FILTER (WHERE d.d_week_seq = tw.week_1998) > av.average_sales
)
SELECT
    'store' AS ty_channel,
    i_brand_id AS ty_brand,
    i_class_id AS ty_class,
    i_category_id AS ty_category,
    ty_sales,
    ty_number_sales,
    'store' AS ly_channel,
    i_brand_id AS ly_brand,
    i_class_id AS ly_class,
    i_category_id AS ly_category,
    ly_sales,
    ly_number_sales
FROM store_agg
ORDER BY ty_channel, ty_brand, ty_class, ty_category
LIMIT 100;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Replace the item-level cross_items CTE (INTERSECT + join back to item producing item_sk) with a brand/class/category level intersection (cross_brands). Since the main query already joins item and filters i_category/i_manager_id and groups by brand/class/category, filtering directly on cross_brands is equivalent and eliminates an expensive redundant CTE join.

Merge the separate this_year and last_year subqueries into a single aggregation over store_sales using conditional aggregation (FILTER on the two target d_week_seq values), avoiding two scans of store_sales/item/date_dim and replacing the final self-join on brand/class/category.

Replace nested INTERSECT set operations with per-channel DISTINCT CTEs (store_brands, catalog_brands, web_brands) joined together, enabling hash joins instead of repeated set-operator sorts. Use explicit JOIN syntax throughout.

Rewrite avg_sales as per-channel SUM/COUNT aggregates combined into a global average (SUM(sales_amt)/SUM(row_cnt)), reducing input to the final aggregation; the CTE is materialized once and cross-joined into the HAVING clause instead of repeated scalar subqueries.
Fold 1998 + 2 into 2000 and 1998 + 1 into 1999, and compute the two target week_seq values once in a target_weeks CTE instead of repeated correlated scalar subqueries.
